annotations.text: The hero is the thesis: one question, two dates, two correct answers. Evidence lands at 18ms; the prose hatches while the model works.

The chat, done for this domain. The as-of is pinned to the exchange and sits on the input, not in the model's memory - the endpoint has no date parameter at all. A turn that needs evidence the set does not hold offers to widen rather than fetching silently, and a new date is a new question.
SUPERSEDED is the signature element. Half this corpus is law that no longer applies, and a reader has to see that at a glance rather than by reading a date.
